search_scope: All 6040 indexed chunks; no chapter filter
label_policy: All required evidence groups, any alternative within a group. Terminal sentence punctuation is excluded from spans. Each span must fit in an indexed chunk. Labels fixed before retrieval.
review: Source-based authoring by the coding agent; no independent human review.
limitations: Topic-heldout splits within this set; topics overlap earlier project experiments. Annotated evidence is not an exhaustive set of relevant passages.
